SELECT
    f.regional_expenditure_id,
    y.year,
    l.location,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
        UPPER(TRIM(p.particular)),
        '^(DEPARTMENT OF (THE )?|THE )',
        ''
    ) AS particular,
    f.appropriation_amount,
    f.appropriation_value_status,
    f.obligation_amount,
    f.obligation_value_status,
    f.processed_at
FROM pondolens.dev_gold.fact_regional_expenditure f
JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_year y
    ON f.year_id = y.year_id
JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_location l
    ON f.location_id = l.location_id
JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_particular p
    ON f.particular_id = p.particular_id
WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(
          UPPER(TRIM(p.particular)),
          '[.]+$',
          ''
      ) NOT IN (
          'ALL', 'TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL'
      )
ORDER BY
    y.year,
    l.location,
    particular

WITH particular_yearly AS (
    -- Department appropriations across regions, Nationwide and Central Office.
    SELECT
        y.year,
        UPPER(TRIM(p.particular)) AS particular,
        SUM(fe.appropriation_amount) AS total_appropriation_php
    FROM pondolens.dev_gold.fact_regional_expenditure fe
    INNER JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_year y
        ON fe.year_id = y.year_id
    INNER JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_particular p
        ON fe.particular_id = p.particular_id
    INNER JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_location l
        ON fe.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE y.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
      AND UPPER(TRIM(p.category)) = 'DEPARTMENTS'
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(l.geographic_level)) = 'REGION'
          OR UPPER(TRIM(l.location_code)) IN (
              'NW', 'CO', 'NATIONWIDE', 'CENTRAL OFFICE'
          )
      )
      AND UPPER(TRIM(p.particular)) NOT IN (
          '', 'ALL', 'TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL'
      )
    GROUP BY
        y.year,
        UPPER(TRIM(p.particular))
),

particular_ranked AS (
    -- Find the top three departments independently for each year.
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY year
            ORDER BY
                total_appropriation_php DESC NULLS LAST,
                particular ASC
        ) AS particular_rank
    FROM particular_yearly
),

grouped AS (
    -- Combine the remaining departments into Others.
    SELECT
        year,
        CASE
            WHEN particular_rank <= 3 THEN particular
            ELSE 'OTHER DEPARTMENTS'
        END AS particular_group,
        SUM(total_appropriation_php) AS total_appropriation_php
    FROM particular_ranked
    GROUP BY
        year,
        CASE
            WHEN particular_rank <= 3 THEN particular
            ELSE 'OTHER DEPARTMENTS'
        END
),

yearly_totals AS (
    -- Denominator includes department appropriations only.
    SELECT
        year,
        SUM(total_appropriation_php) AS yearly_total_php
    FROM particular_yearly
    GROUP BY year
)

SELECT
    g.year,
    CASE
        WHEN g.particular_group = 'OTHER DEPARTMENTS'
            THEN g.particular_group
        ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(
            g.particular_group,
            '^(DEPARTMENT OF (THE )?|THE )',
            ''
        )
    END AS particular_group,
    g.total_appropriation_php,
    t.yearly_total_php,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * g.total_appropriation_php
        / NULLIF(t.yearly_total_php, 0),
        4
    ) AS percentage_share
FROM grouped g
INNER JOIN yearly_totals t
    ON g.year = t.year
ORDER BY
    g.year,
    g.total_appropriation_php DESC

WITH location_yearly AS (
    -- Appropriations across all categories, including NW and CO.
    SELECT
        y.year,
        l.location_code,
        UPPER(TRIM(l.geographic_level)) AS geographic_level,
        SUM(fe.appropriation_amount) AS total_appropriation_php
    FROM pondolens.dev_gold.fact_regional_expenditure fe
    INNER JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_year y
        ON fe.year_id = y.year_id
    INNER JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_particular p
        ON fe.particular_id = p.particular_id
    INNER JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_location l
        ON fe.location_id = l.location_id
    WHERE y.year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
      AND (
          UPPER(TRIM(l.geographic_level)) = 'REGION'
          OR UPPER(TRIM(l.location_code)) IN (
              'NW', 'CO', 'NATIONWIDE', 'CENTRAL OFFICE'
          )
      )
      AND UPPER(TRIM(p.particular)) NOT IN (
          '', 'ALL', 'TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL'
      )
    GROUP BY
        y.year,
        l.location_code,
        UPPER(TRIM(l.geographic_level))
),

yearly_totals AS (
    -- Denominator includes regions, Nationwide and Central Office.
    SELECT
        year,
        SUM(total_appropriation_php) AS yearly_total_including_nw_co_php
    FROM location_yearly
    GROUP BY year
)

SELECT
    ly.year,
    ly.location_code AS region,
    ly.total_appropriation_php,
    yt.yearly_total_including_nw_co_php,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * ly.total_appropriation_php
        / NULLIF(yt.yearly_total_including_nw_co_php, 0),
        4
    ) AS percentage_share
FROM location_yearly ly
INNER JOIN yearly_totals yt
    ON ly.year = yt.year
WHERE ly.geographic_level = 'REGION'
  AND UPPER(TRIM(ly.location_code)) NOT IN (
      'NW', 'CO', 'NATIONWIDE', 'CENTRAL OFFICE'
  )
  AND ly.total_appropriation_php IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    ly.year,
    ly.total_appropriation_php DESC

WITH regions AS (
 SELECT location_id, location_code, location FROM pondolens.dev_gold.dim_location
 WHERE LOWER(TRIM(geographic_level)) = 'region'
), obligations AS (
 SELECT f.year_id, f.location_id, SUM(f.obligation_amount) AS obligations_php
 FROM pondolens.dev_gold.fact_regional_expenditure f
 JOIN regions r ON r.location_id=f.location_id
 JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_particular p ON p.particular_id=f.particular_id
 WHERE UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(p.category,''))) <> 'UNKNOWN'
 AND f.obligation_amount IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY f.year_id,f.location_id
), age_groups AS (
 SELECT a.age_group_id FROM pondolens.dev_gold.dim_age_group a
 WHERE a.age_min IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM pondolens.dev_gold.dim_age_group b
 WHERE b.age_group_id <> a.age_group_id
 AND COALESCE(b.age_min,0)>=COALESCE(a.age_min,0)
 AND COALESCE(b.age_max,999)<=COALESCE(a.age_max,999)
 AND (COALESCE(b.age_min,0)>COALESCE(a.age_min,0) OR COALESCE(b.age_max,999)<COALESCE(a.age_max,999))
 )
), population AS (
 SELECT fp.year_id,fp.location_id,SUM(fp.population_count) AS population
 FROM pondolens.dev_gold.fact_population fp
 JOIN regions r ON r.location_id=fp.location_id
 JOIN age_groups ag ON ag.age_group_id=fp.age_group_id
 GROUP BY fp.year_id,fp.location_id
), matched AS (
 SELECT y.year,r.location_code,r.location AS region,o.obligations_php,p.population
 FROM obligations o JOIN population p ON p.year_id=o.year_id AND p.location_id=o.location_id
 JOIN regions r ON r.location_id=o.location_id
 JOIN pondolens.dev_gold.dim_year y ON y.year_id=o.year_id
 WHERE p.population > 0
), metrics AS (
 SELECT *,SUM(obligations_php) OVER(PARTITION BY year) AS national_obligations_php,
 SUM(population) OVER(PARTITION BY year) AS national_population
 FROM matched
)
SELECT year,location_code,region,population,obligations_php,
 ROUND(obligations_php / NULLIF(population,0),2) AS per_resident,
 ROUND(national_obligations_php / NULLIF(national_population,0),2) AS national_per_resident,
 ROUND(100.0*(obligations_php/NULLIF(population,0))/(national_obligations_php/NULLIF(national_population,0)),2) AS per_100_national,
 ROUND(100.0*(obligations_php/NULLIF(population,0))/(national_obligations_php/NULLIF(national_population,0))-100,2) AS diff_from_100,
 CASE WHEN obligations_php/NULLIF(population,0)>=national_obligations_php/NULLIF(national_population,0)
 THEN 'Above national average' ELSE 'Below national average' END AS vs_national,
 ROUND(100.0*population/NULLIF(national_population,0),2) AS population_share_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*obligations_php/NULLIF(national_obligations_php,0),2) AS spending_share_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*obligations_php/NULLIF(national_obligations_php,0)-100.0*population/NULLIF(national_population,0),2) AS share_gap_pp,
 ROUND(obligations_php/NULLIF(population,0),2) AS spending_per_person_php,
 location_code AS region_code
 FROM metrics

    yt.yearly_regional_total_php,

        4
    ) AS percentage_share

measures.name: selected_region
measures.comment: Shows the region in scope; returns All when multiple regions are included
measures.expr:
CASE
  WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT `region`) > 1 THEN 'All'
  ELSE MAX(`region`)
END

measures.name: region_budget
measures.comment: Total budget of the selected region; a dash when multiple regions are included
measures.expr:
CASE
  WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT `region`) > 1 THEN '-'
  ELSE FORMAT_NUMBER(SUM(`total_appropriation_php`), '#,##0')
END
